name: tasknotes-macos
description: Turbo shim over the native macOS TaskNotes app. Only `lint` participates in the repository's Linux verify graph — SwiftLint ships a static Linux binary, so it runs in CI, while every `mac:` script needs a Swift toolchain or Xcode and is a local pre-merge step, by the same rule the iOS app already follows. Every script that compiles Swift runs `mac:preflight` first: the committed bindings are generated source and the XCFramework they link against is a gitignored artifact, so regenerating one without rebuilding the other produces `Undefined symbol: _uniffi_…` that reads as somebody else's broken edit rather than a stale build.

scripts.mac:snapshots: bun run mac:preflight && swift test --filter TaskNotesMacTests
scripts.mac:format: xcrun swift-format format --in-place --parallel --recursive Sources Tests App Package.swift
scripts.mac:format:check: xcrun swift-format lint --strict --parallel --recursive Sources Tests App Package.swift
scripts.mac:analyze: xcodebuild -project TaskNotes.xcodeproj -scheme TaskNotes -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath .build/xcode clean build > .build/xcodebuild.log && swiftlint analyze --strict --quiet --config .swiftlint-analyzer.yml --compiler-log-path .build/xcodebuild.log
scripts.mac:e2e: bun run mac:generate && xcodebuild test -project TaskNotes.xcodeproj -scheme TaskNotes -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath .build/xcode -destination 'platform=macOS' -only-testing:TaskNotesUITests
scripts.mac:verify: bun run mac:generate && bun run mac:build && bun run mac:test && bun run lint && bun run mac:format:check && bun run mac:app
